low.title: Full-Day Hallstatt History Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: A budget-friendly deep dive into Hallstatt’s ancient salt-mining heritage, classic alpine architecture, and lakeside historical spots.

schedule.title: Lakeside Historical Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start with a calm walk along the lake, reading historical info boards and observing centuries-old wooden houses.

schedule.title: Old Town + Marktplatz Timeline Walk
schedule.description: Explore the heart of Hallstatt — the marketplace, old façades, and traditional buildings that reflect centuries of alpine life.

schedule.title: Budget Bakery Stop
schedule.description: Grab a pastry or simple sandwich before heading uphill — fuel for exploring the origins of the world’s oldest salt-mining community.

schedule.title: Funicular Ride to the Salt Mine
schedule.description: Take the budget ticket uphill or hike if you want extra savings — enjoy views that historically protected the settlement.

schedule.title: Salt Mine Exterior & Historical Displays
schedule.description: Even without entering, the outdoor exhibits give insight into 7,000 years of continuous settlement.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a simple Austrian hot meal — goulash, noodles, or a daily menu — classic miner-style comfort food.

schedule.title: Church Area + Ossuary Exterior
schedule.description: Walk around the church and nearby cemetery to see centuries of carved wooden decorations and alpine memorial traditions.

schedule.title: Sunset Over Historical Hallstatt
schedule.description: Finish by watching the village’s old houses glow in the evening light — the perfect historical full-day wrap-up.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Hallstatt History Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable day exploring Hallstatt’s origins, salt-mining legacy, archaeological finds, and historic old town corners.

schedule.title: Coffee + Lakefront History Intro
schedule.description: Start at a medium-priced café near the water, reading about Hallstatt’s UNESCO recognition and early settlement.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum — Historical Highlights
schedule.description: Visit curated exhibitions about the Hallstatt culture, archaeological discoveries, and life in prehistoric times.

schedule.title: Medium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy classic Austrian meals inspired by local miner traditions — hearty and satisfying.

schedule.title: Funicular Ride + Salt Mine Tour (Optional)
schedule.description: Take a ride to the ancient salt mine — the oldest in the world — and explore tunnels shaped by millennia of mining.

schedule.title: Skywalk Historical Overview
schedule.description: From high above the town, appreciate how the geography shaped Hallstatt’s architectural and cultural evolution.

schedule.title: Old Town Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Study wooden balconies, traditional steep-roof houses, and narrow alleys built to fit the mountainside.

schedule.title: Evening Historical Promenade
schedule.description: End your day where history meets calm — along the lake, just as generations before.

high.title: High-End Hallstatt History Day
high.summary: A refined historical route with deeper museum exploration, full salt mine experience, and elegant local cuisine.

schedule.title: High-Quality Breakfast with Historical Views
schedule.description: Start the day in a stylish café overlooking traditional alpine houses and the lake.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum — Full Historical Tour
schedule.description: Dive into Hallstatt’s archaeological treasures, ancient burial objects, and cultural artifacts.

schedule.title: Premium Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined Austrian dishes inspired by the region’s mining heritage and alpine ingredients.

schedule.title: Salt Mine Guided Experience
schedule.description: Take a guided tour into the prehistoric salt tunnels — one of the oldest industrial sites on Earth.

schedule.title: Skywalk + Historical Panorama
schedule.description: Stand above the village and picture how Hallstatt evolved over thousands of years.

schedule.title: Village Architecture & Heritage Loop
schedule.description: Explore the most characteristic historical zones — narrow stepped paths, old workshops, and traditional houses.

schedule.title: Dinner with Lakefront Heritage Ambience
schedule.description: Finish with a beautifully prepared dinner while watching the old town lights reflect on the water.

comfortable.title: Luxury Full-Day Historical Journey Through Hallstatt
comfortable.summary: A curated, luxury-level historical day with guided museum insights, salt mine exploration, fine dining, and the most scenic heritage viewpoints.

schedule.title: Elegant Breakfast in a Heritage Hotel
schedule.description: Begin your day surrounded by traditional architecture while enjoying a premium breakfast.

schedule.title: Private or Curated Museum Tour
schedule.description: Get an in-depth look at Hallstatt’s archaeological collections, historical objects, and cultural heritage displays.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Heritage Lunch
schedule.description: Indulge in a sophisticated alpine meal inspired by local traditions.

schedule.title: VIP Salt Mine Tour Experience
schedule.description: Take your time exploring the world’s oldest known salt mine with exclusive pacing and depth.

schedule.title: Skywalk Signature Heritage View
schedule.description: Experience a stunning panoramic view that visually explains Hallstatt’s historical layout.

schedule.title: Exclusive Old Town Heritage Stroll
schedule.description: Walk the most photogenic and historically rich streets — including quiet corners with preserved wooden structures.

schedule.title: Luxury Dinner with Nighttime Heritage Atmosphere
schedule.description: End the day with fine dining as the lake reflects the softly lit historical village.
